references.text: The foundational Sabbath command in the Ten Commandments: 'Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy' - the same instruction to keep the Sabbaths
The Sabbath as a sign between God and Israel: 'My Sabbaths you shall keep' - identical wording with שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ
Nearly identical verse combining reverence and Sabbath holiness: 'My Sabbaths you shall keep'
Verbatim repetition of the same command: 'My Sabbaths you shall keep, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the Lord'
Command to build a sanctuary where God will dwell among the people - background for reverence toward the sanctuary (מִקְדָּשׁ)
Repetition of the Sabbath command in Deuteronomy: 'Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy'
The book of Hebrews speaks of a Sabbath rest awaiting God's people - theological continuation of the Sabbath concept
